name: Light Wishlist
author: codebyza

sections.description:
Light Wishlist is a simple and fast wishlist plugin for WooCommerce. It offers a minimal UI with customization options directly from the WordPress admin.

Features:

  • Add/remove products to/from wishlist with AJAX.
  • Works with logged-in users.
  • Fully translatable and customizable.
  • Admin settings page for icon, color, text, and layout.
  • Supports Elementor and Oxygen Builder (optional toggles).
  • Auto-insert wishlist button in WooCommerce product loops (configurable).
  • Shortcodes and PHP functions available for custom placement.
  • Uses FontAwesome icons.

Shortcodes Available:

  • [light-wishlist-add-item] – Render the wishlist button manually.
  • [wishlist-user-table] – Display the user’s wishlist table.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Wishlist to configure icons, text, and other options.
sections.faq:
Can I change the wishlist icon?

Yes, you can choose from several FontAwesome icons in the settings.

Is it compatible with page builders?

Yes, it supports Elementor and Oxygen. Enable support from the plugin settings.

Does it use cookies or sessions?

No. Wishlist is stored in the database for logged-in users only.

Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is required for this plugin to function.
